blind.description: A compact industrial wall-mounted lever or switch, oriented standing vertically on one edge. It consists of a rectangular metallic mounting plate with beveled edges and corner bolts, a central pivot bracket mechanism, and an upright lever arm capped by a smooth spherical orange-red ball handle. The surfaces are solid, cleanly modeled, and continuous, with painted metallic grey textures and mechanical detailing.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a thin rectangular bar representing the top edge of the base plate, with the spherical orange knob and lever pivot protruding centrally.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 to 1/5 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 1.2 to 1.4 feet tall) and about 6 to 8 inches wide.
